state:
Goal `core-sse-and-2-more`. Every `Core\Sse` and `Core\Sse\Message` feature has all its proofs, and
`bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Sse' --group 'Core\Sse\Message'` passes. `nvs run --request`
now offers every request the SSE cell, and a stream a request's `Core\Sse::upgrade` opened starts
once the request ends, fed from `--events` when given (`crates/nvs-cli/src/events.rs` `connect`,
module doc). `Core\Storage` is the one group still red: it owes a class card, and `get`, `delete` and
`list` each owe examples, an attack, a bench and a Rust `covers:` marker.

items.text: **`Core\Storage` class card** — `rule:core-api/reference-card`: a `ClassDoc` above the class's `CLASS` row at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/storage.rs:168`, and `Core\Storage` struck from `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs:5283`. Check with `nvs agent find Storage` and `nvs agent show 'Core\Storage'`.

**`covers:` markers on the Rust tests of `get`, `delete` and `list`** — `rule:testing/proof-attribution`: the members are `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/storage.rs:514`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/storage.rs:534` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/storage.rs:552`; mark the `#[test]`s in that file's test module that already exercise each.

**`get`, `delete` and `list` proofs** — `rule:testing/feature-proofs`: `about.md`, three examples, one attack and one bench each, paths from `bun nv proofs --id 'Core\Storage::get'`, and each example calls the member at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/storage.rs:514`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/storage.rs:534` or `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/storage.rs:552`. Whether a proof needs an `nvs.toml` beside it naming a disk is not checked; `put`'s landed proofs under `docs/examples/core/Storage/put/` are the model if it has them.

backlog: `crates/nvs-cli/tests/live_config.rs:1389`'s `a_changed_queue_worker_count_starts_and_stops_workers_after_their_current_job` missed its 30s wait once beside the other test binaries and passes alone in about 10s; it needs its own time budget or a signal rather than a wait (`tools/nv/cmd/verify.ts` module doc).
Nothing else is open in this goal once `Core\Storage` passes; then `DONE` after `bun nv verify --doc`, `bun nv owners --closes core-sse-and-2-more` and `bun nv playbook --closes core-sse-and-2-more`.
